newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn steady to firmer, soy up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn steady to firmer, soy up.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn offers were mostly steady to firmer on Monday while nearby soybeans positions rose by two to four cents a bushel. Wheat values remained flat.
One exporter said there was a little bit of movement in corn and soybeans but noted there could be logistical problems due to icy conditions on the river system.

In export news, Pakistan on Monday bought a total of 315,000 tonnes wheat, of which 180,000 tonnes was Australian wheat and 135,000 tonnes was U.S. soft white wheat for February 1-28 delivery, several U.S. exporters said.
